body:
alex: Morning — quick async check for the kernel/batcher folks. One-liners: what you did yesterday / blockers / today. I'll kick it off.

alex: Yesterday: landed the microbatch allocator fix and validated slot handoff on staging.

alex: Blockers: seeing an ~8% throughput drop on seq=1024 workloads on A100 pool; appears during sustained runs. Suspect scheduler interaction with our new allocator. Need someone to eyeball kernel logs.

tara: I can take a look this morning. Which job id and where are the logs?

alex: job id job-2024-04-kv79, logs at s3://redwood-ops/logs/2024/job-2024-04-kv79/. PR with allocator changes is #4723.

kevin: Yesterday: ran a prefix-KV warmup sweep + tuned eviction heuristic. Warmup hit went 94% -> 97% after tweak.

kevin: Benchmark snapshot (internal): model=redwood-lite, batch=4, seq=512 => p50=16ms, p95=48ms, p99=122ms. Command used: `bench run --model redwood-lite --batch=4 --seq=512`.

rita: Quick heads up — left a couple of nits on PR #4723. Also bumped canary threshold to 0.6 in the rollout config while we triage.

tara: Looking at kernel logs now. Noticed slot thrash around 11:23 UTC that lines up with a background cuDNN memory compaction / GC event on the node.

benchbot: AUTO: nightly-bench job 1758002200 finished. Summary: redwood-lite q4 tokens/sec +4.2%, cost/token -1.1%. See /bench/reports/1758002200.csv.

kevin: Quick repro snippet: `python perf_probe.py --job job2024 --mode trace` shows repeated kernel recompile at step 3 for some sequences. I'll paste the trace to the PR.

alex: Good — kevin, please attach the repro and traces to PR #4723. Tara, can you check whether the GC aligns with driver/kernel versions? I'll file an issue for follow-up.

rita: On it. Also quick ops note: code freeze for dedicated deploys next Wednesday — folks with rollout changes please flag your PRs.

alex: Plan for today: triage the kernel scheduling interaction, run a microbench with kernel pinning (no recompile) to isolate variance. If anyone needs review priority, ping me and I'll bump it.

tara: I'll run a kernel vs driver matrix today and post a small result table (driver, cuDNN, p95) back here.

kevin: I'll add the perf CSV and the `perf_probe` output to the PR and kick a focused microbench for seq=1024 (batch=2/4).

benchbot: NOTE: canary group `warmup-2` currently at 0.45 rollout and healthy.

rita: QA ask: can we keep warmup TTL=30s for the next run? That setting improved steady-state in the last run. :thumbsup:

alex: Yes, leave TTL=30s for the isolations.

kevin: Minor blocker: need read access to /var/log/kernel_scheduler on the canary nodes to correlate timestamps. Filed infra ticket INF-214.

tara: INF-214 acknowledged by infra; they'll grant read-only access and notify when done.

alex: Great. Thanks everyone. If anything becomes high priority, DM me. Otherwise we'll reconvene in this thread tomorrow morning. :coffee:
